ui.switch_note: Language switching reloads the page. Saved inspections and reviews are retained.
ui.batch_help: Upload 1-20 images of the same product (20 MB each, 100 MB total). Invalid images are recorded as failures; remaining images continue. Every result is saved locally.
ui.batch_done: Batch {batch}: {success} completed, {failed} failed. All {total} inputs are accounted for.
ui.history_help: Single-image, batch, comparison and challenge inspections are saved in this project only. Counts describe operations, not benchmark accuracy or unique products. Filters apply to both charts and CSV.
ui.review_help: Human conclusions are appended separately. They never overwrite the original model result or train the detector. Multiple reviews of a record are retained.
ui.review_saved: Review saved. The original AI report is unchanged.
ui.review_pending: Select and load a successful inspection before reviewing.
ui.compare_help: Inspect the same image with both models. Raw scores use different scales: compare each score with its own frozen threshold. Both results enter the inspection history.
ui.compare_done: Saved {count} model results. A ratio above 1 means the image score exceeds that model’s own threshold; it is not a defect probability.
ui.challenge_help: Explore brightness and blur using the same frozen model. The original and transformed image are inspected together. This demonstration does not change calibration or establish robustness benchmark results.
ui.challenge_done: Both variants are saved as image-quality challenge records. Compare input quality and the recommendation, not just the anomaly score.
ui.summary: Showing {visible} of {total} matching records. Export includes every matching record.

errors.file_size: Image is missing or exceeds 20 MB.
errors.image_size: Images must be at least 32 pixels per side and within 16 million pixels.
errors.invalid_image: This file is not a readable image.
errors.invalid_model: The selected product and fitted model do not match or are unavailable.
errors.no_image: Upload an image or load a demonstration example first.
errors.invalid_review: Enter a reviewer name (up to 80 characters) and a valid conclusion; notes allow 2,000 characters.
errors.record_missing: The selected record no longer exists.
errors.failed_record_review: A failed image has no AI result to review.
errors.invalid_report: The inspection result could not be saved.
errors.selection_changed: The record is still loading. Load it before saving a review.

ui.daily_title: A cracked floor tile in a dormitory or home
ui.daily_help: Scenario: a resident reports a suspected floor-tile crack. Compare both models, assess the image quality, then record a human review. The reference example is a public MVTec AD image, not a household photograph.
ui.daily_reference: Public dataset example - a simulated daily-life inspection, not field validation.
ui.daily_uploaded: Uploaded daily-life photo - capture conditions may differ from training. Treat the result as an unvalidated suggestion for human review.
ui.daily_done: Saved two daily-life case records: {ids}. Open Records and review to inspect and add your own conclusion. This case does not enter benchmark accuracy.
ui.daily_steps: 1. Load the reference image or upload a tile photo.  2. Compare the two heatmaps.  3. If the photo is poor, retake it.  4. Add an independent human conclusion in Records and review.

metal_nut.description: Metal nut inspection: compare shape, orientation, color and local surface appearance.

rules.R1: Image brightness or sharpness does not meet the input requirements. Retake the image.
rules.R2: The score is below the review band and the predicted anomalous area is small.
rules.R3: The score is close to the threshold or a suspicious local region is present. Manual review is recommended.
rules.R4: A clear anomaly intersects the demonstration critical region or exceeds the area limit.
rules.R5: The anomaly evidence is insufficient for automatic acceptance or rejection. Manual review is recommended.

policies.bottle: Teaching policy for fixed-view top-down bottle images. The critical region and thresholds have not been validated by factory specialists.
policies.metal_nut: Teaching policy using a central rectangular demonstration region for metal nut images. It does not identify an actual functional nut component. The region and thresholds have not been validated by factory specialists and were not tuned using anomalous test results.
policies.tile: Teaching policy using the entire tile image as the demonstration texture region. The region and thresholds have not been validated by factory specialists or tuned using anomalous test results. This is not a tile production quality standard.
policies.synthetic: Teaching policy using a central rectangular region for synthetic washer software checks. It retains the original teaching thresholds and is not applicable to real product quality decisions.
